name: chumchum-crm
description: ChumChum CRM - Inbox đa kênh (Zalo OA, Zalo cá nhân, Messenger, Instagram, TikTok, Shopee) + quản lý khách hàng, đơn hàng, Trello

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.setup: npm run prisma:generate -w apps/api && npm run prisma:migrate -w apps/api && npm run seed -w apps/api
